text:
deploy-bot: starting rollout: service=model-router image=redwood/model-router:3.1.0 window=03:30-05:30UTC strategy=staged 5->20->50->100 (15m ramps). release: https://internal.redwood/releases/3.1.0

anya: heads-up i'm on dashboard watch for latency & error spikes. pinging @tom for traces.

ops-bot: preflight checks passed: infra quotas ok, mem/cpu templates present, canary smoke OK.

oncall-bot: ALERT: model-router (us-east) rate-limited responses 429 spike at 03:37 UTC, 6m sustained. 5xx stable.

tom: seeing a flattening of request concurrency on new pods. 429s look like a throttling from the local rate-limiter in front of model-worker. gathering logs.

ray: quick check: canary weight currently 5%. new pods show config flag `--request-throttle=200r/s` but prod stable is 500r/s. did the config generator default rollback the flag?

release-eng: hmm that would explain it. our templating backfill replaced the old value during the service refactor. not on canary because earlier canary used manual override.

anya: immediate options? increase throttle via live patch, or pause rollout and pin to 3.0.8 until hotfix.

ops-bot: live patch command available: `kubectl patch svc model-router -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"model-router","args": ["--request-throttle=500r/s"]}]}}}}'` — caution: patch will not change image, only args.

tom: i can apply the patch and monitor, but runtime may require rolling restart to pick up args. that could briefly increase error surface. safer to pause + pin.

ray: ping memory/kv-cache metrics: none triggered. it's purely rate-limit mismatch.

anya: i'm leaning pause+pin. which is less risky during change window?

release-eng: agreed, pause rollout. create INC ticket and assign infra to produce a patched image with the corrected default.

deploy-bot: command executed: `/rollout pause service=model-router release=3.1.0 by=anya` — rollout paused at 5%.

deploy-bot: command executed: `/pin release=3.0.8 service=model-router scope=global by=anya` — traffic reverted to 3.0.8.

oncall-bot: Notifying #incidents and paging infra on-call. Incident INC-1427 opened: deploy throttle regression causing 429s in canary/prod ramp.

tom: after pin, 429s dropped to baseline within 90s. dashboard p50/p95 returned to normal.

ray: quick mitigation follow-ups: 1) add unit check comparing templated args vs stable cluster; 2) run a preflight flag diff in CI; 3) add an alert rule for unexpected throttle delta >20%.

anya: infra will build 3.1.0-p1 with corrected default and include a health-check that inspects runtime flags at startup. ETA ~22m.

release-eng: can we also update release notes to call out the flag change so customers can audit config if they maintain non-default overlays?

ops-bot: applied temporary note to release metadata: `chore: corrected request-throttle default; patched image incoming`

tom: suggestion for re-rollout once hotfix available: do a 1% -> 5% -> 15% ramp with 10m dwell and explicit memory/latency checkpoints before each step.

anya: agreed. postmortem/learnings to include automated flag-compare preflight and a small e2e that exercises throttling path.

release-eng: assigning follow-ups in INC-1427: infra - produce patched image; ci - add flag-diff check; release - update notes and internal changelog.

oncall-bot: Incident INC-1427: state=triaged, assignees=[infra-oncall, release-eng]. Quiet after pin. :white_check_mark:

anya: TL;DR: Rollout paused + pin to 3.0.8, hotfix build in progress for 3.1.0-p1, follow-ups in INC-1427. I'll monitor for 20m then hand off.

tom: i'll take traces and validate hotfix when ready. thanks all. :thumbsup:
